newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amrad Corp shares debut at premium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amrad Corp shares debut at premium.

text.p: Shares in pharmaceutical group Amrad Corp Ltd made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange at A$2.30 per share, an 18 percent premium to its issue price of A$1.95.
Amrad is involved in the development and commercialisation of Australian medical research and has formal agreements with 11 medical and scientific research institutes.
The company offered 35.98 million shares for subscription out of a total of 102.9 million shares on issue.
The issue was underwritten by Burdett, Buckeridge and Young.
By 11.50 a.m. (0050 GMT), Amrad shares had settled at A$2.21, up 26 cents on their issue price on turnover of 2.53 million shares.
